note: Evaluation protocols a task can name. 'requires' is what the model adapter must return. Values marked TO BE DECIDED are open; the PANGAEA values are copied from its configs (configs/train.yaml, optimizer/adamw.yaml, lr_scheduler/multi_step_lr.yaml, task/segmentation.yaml, decoder/seg_upernet*.yaml).

protocols.summary: Encoder frozen, no training. k-nearest-neighbour classification on pooled embeddings.
protocols.why: Measures the embedding alone; no optimiser choices to tune.

protocols.summary: Encoder frozen. A linear layer on the pooled embedding (image-level tasks) or on the last layer's patch tokens, upsampled to the target grid (dense tasks).
protocols.why: Every surveyed model can produce this, including Clay and AnySat, which expose no intermediate layers.

protocols.summary: PANGAEA default: encoder frozen, UPerNet decoder on four encoder layers. Multi-temporal inputs are combined by L-TAE before the decoder.

requires.feature_maps: four layers, with their strides declared

settings.lr_schedule: multi-step, decay at 60% and 90% of iterations

protocols.why: Comparable with published PANGAEA results. Mixes encoder quality with decoder fit, and is unusable for models without intermediate layers.

protocols.summary: Encoder and decoder trained together (PANGAEA finetune: true).
protocols.why: Closest to how practitioners use a model; most expensive and most sensitive to tuning.
